bio: Escape the hustle and bustle of Edinburgh's city centre and enjoy a scrumptious Afternoon Tea in the stylish surroundings of Le Monde Bar & Restaurant.  Housed inside the boutique Le Monde Hotel, Le Monde Bar & Restaurant is a chic dining space, boasting a marble-topped bar, velvet booths and atmospheric lighting. Sit back, relax and soak up the glamour as you indulge in the Great British tradition of Afternoon Tea  Sitting elegantly on a three-tiered cake stand, their Afternoon Tea menu features a selection of freshly cut sandwich bites, buttery scones and an array of delectable cakes and pastries. All of this is served alongside your choice of tea or coffee and a glass of Prosecco or, if you're feeling particularly decadent, a chilled glass of Champagne!  Le Monde Hotel sits within the bustling centre of Edinburgh, just a short walk from Waverley train station and within easy reach of some of the city's main attractions including Edinburgh Castle and the Scottish National Gallery.
